Cable travel from straight

Strip cable, +y side (to the sacrum)–
Strip cable, −y side–
Tentacle A (top), housing + bare cable–
Tentacle B (+y side)–
Tentacle C (bottom)–

Negative = pulled in, positive = pays out. Geometry only: the strip cables are measured from the back of the skull to the dead end past rod 7, the tentacle cables from the back of the skull along the housing lanes and through the discs to the tip cap. A curled strip is a polyline of 4 in rigid pieces, a few millimetres off the true arc.
